snippet.title: Puzzling Places - Monthly Pack #6: Remarkable Rooms
snippet.description:
A brand new puzzle pack - the "Monthly Pack #6: Remarkable Rooms" is here! 

Poke your head into four new beautiful rooms from around the world! Available today for $3.99!

This DLC Puzzle Pack includes:
- Cracovian Bedroom (Kraków, Poland)
- The Haus - Room #106 (Berlin, Germany)
- Nazaretian Office (Gaziantep, Turkey)
- The Gassia House (Lleida, Spain)

Special thanks to Daniel Sproll, Azad Balabanian, Giravolt, and the Malopolska Virtual Museums for providing photogrammetry scans! Detailed information about each puzzle: https://puzzlingplaces.ghost.io/m6/
